description: Inertial Labs MRU-B1 and MRU-B1.1 are the Basic (B) motion reference units of the Inertial Labs MRU range. Both use solid state MEMS 3-axis gyroscopes, accelerometers and a barometric sensor in a small IP67 housing (120 x 50 x 53 mm, 220 g), with a subsea version (S) also offered. They output in Inertial Labs binary, NMEA 0183 ASCII, TSS1 and Kongsberg/Seatex, SMC and Teledyne formats and carry ABS design assessment. The two models differ only in what they measure: MRU-B1 is the heave sensor and MRU-B1.1 is the pitch and roll sensor.

specs.v: Heave (with heave velocity and acceleration), per datasheet part description 'Heave Sensor'. Inertial Labs website table lists Heave, Surge and Sway. No pitch/roll or heading.
Pitch and Roll only (datasheet 'Pitch & Roll Sensor'). No heave, no heading.
Heave, Surge, Sway, Pitch and Roll. Same pitch/roll accuracy 0.02 deg RMS. Datasheet also lists B22 (0.01 deg) in the B2 group.
Heave 5% or 5 cm RMS (B1, B2); pitch and roll 0.02 deg RMS dynamic, 0.005 deg resolution, range +/-90 and +/-180 deg (B1.1, B2)

Update rate 1 to 200 Hz; supply 9 to 36 VDC; 1 W (2 W with optional 64 GB logger); interface option .15 RS-232+Ethernet, .125 adds RS-422, .1245 adds CAN; operating -40 to +70 C; IP67 (subsea version 245 x 140 x 115 mm, 6.57 kg)
